description: Golden fixtures for WING-010 style controls. Every case uses the same conversation. 'raw_model_text' cases feed one identical model draft through different style profiles and record the text after the generator's deterministic style caps. 'style_following' cases use a deterministic mock model keyed on the style directives it finds in the prompt (standing in for a model that follows them), and record the prompt directives and the resulting draft.

conversation.text: Just got back from a hike up Mount Tam, my legs are dead

raw_model_text: Haha that's amazing!! 😂🔥🙌 Was the view worth the climb?

style_following_cases.name: lowercase_minimal_very_short
expected_directives: Punctuation: minimal. Lowercase is fine, skip most periods, no exclamation marks.
Emoji: none. Do not use any emoji.
Length: very short. One short line, under 60 characters.
Tone: direct and to the point.

style_following_cases.name: expressive_playful_emoji
expected_directives: Punctuation: expressive. Exclamation marks and '...' are welcome where they fit.
Emoji: frequent. Use emoji freely where they fit naturally.
Length: short. One or two sentences, under 160 characters.
Humor: playful. Kind, gentle teasing is fine.
style_following_cases.expected_text: Dead legs means you earned it! 😂🥾 Was the view worth the climb?!

style_following_cases.name: warm_medium_occasional
expected_directives: Emoji: occasional. At most two emoji where they fit.
Length: medium. Two to four sentences, under 400 characters.
Humor: light. A light touch where it is natural.
style_following_cases.expected_text: That sounds like a great hike, and your legs have earned a rest 🙂 Was the view worth the climb? I'd love to hear how it went.

style_following_cases.name: formal_reserved_no_humor
expected_directives: Emoji: none. Do not use any emoji.
style_following_cases.expected_text: That sounds like a wonderful hike. Was the view worth the climb?
